items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a woven bread basket overloaded with forty glossy garlic breadsticks, packed upright until the weave splits and the rest spill sideways in drifts across a rustic stucco-and-terracotta table setting, butter sheen pooling on the cloth, coarse salt and herb flecks scattered, two more refilled baskets crowding the frame edge, a corner of a painted Tuscan mural blurred at the top of frame. Warm golden-hour light through a shuttered window, honeyed highlights, olive-toned shadows, faux-Mediterranean warmth. Camera: overhead flat-lay, 50mm, deep focus, high micro-contrast, honeyed colour. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. items.imagePrompt: A careless snapshot taken on an old cheap smartphone by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a deep aluminium catering pan of baked pasta, easily curb-deep, its cardboard lid leaning against the side, browned cheese crust broken open at one corner to show layered ziti and meat sauce underneath, a long serving spoon standing upright in it. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow cast and no fill, flat and shadowless with mixed white balance. Framed crooked with the pan cut off at both edges, a stainless prep counter and a stack of empty pans behind..
